description: User and device identifiers are not managed throughout their lifecycle including creation, use, and deactivation. This signal indicates that stale, shared, or orphaned identifiers may exist without proper controls.
applicability: Applicable to all identity management systems. Includes user account provisioning, deprovisioning, periodic reviews, and identifier uniqueness enforcement.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through identity management process review, orphaned account discovery, and identifier uniqueness verification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Identification and Authentication
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
